old: Which none of the princes of this world knew: for had they known it, they would not have crucified Yahuah (Lord) of glory.
new: Which none of the princes of this world knew: for had they known it, they would not have crucified Adonai (Lord) of glory.

old: For I know nothing by myself; yet am I not hereby justified: but he that judgeth me is Yahuah (Lord).
new: For I know nothing by myself; yet am I not hereby justified: but he that judgeth me is Yahusha (Lord).

old: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until Yahuah (Lord) come, who both will bring to light the hidden things of darkness, and will make manifest the counsels of the hearts: and then shall every man have praise of Elohim (God).
new: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until Yahusha (Lord) come, who both will bring to light the hidden things of darkness, and will make manifest the counsels of the hearts: and then shall every man have praise of Elohim (God).

old: For this cause have I sent unto you Timotheus, who is my beloved son, and faithful in Yahuah (Lord), who shall bring you into remembrance of my ways which be in Messiah (Christ), as I teach every where in every church.
new: For this cause have I sent unto you Timotheus, who is my beloved son, and faithful in Yahusha (Lord), who shall bring you into remembrance of my ways which be in Messiah (Christ), as I teach every where in every church.

old: Meats for the belly, and the belly for meats: but Elohim (God) shall destroy both it and them. Now the body is not for fornication, but for Yahuah (Lord); and Yahuah (Lord) for the body.
new: Meats for the belly, and the belly for meats: but Elohim (God) shall destroy both it and them. Now the body is not for fornication, but for Yahusha (Lord); and Yahusha (Lord) for the body.

old: And Elohim (God) hath both raised up Yahuah (Lord), and will also raise up us by his own power.
new: And Elohim (God) hath both raised up Yahusha (Lord), and will also raise up us by his own power.

old: But he that is joined unto Yahuah (Lord) is one spirit.
new: But he that is joined unto Yahusha (Lord) is one spirit.

old: And unto the married I command, yet not I, but Yahuah (Lord), Let not the wife depart from her husband:
new: And unto the married I command, yet not I, but Yahusha (Lord), Let not the wife depart from her husband:

old: But to the rest speak I, not Yahuah (Lord): If any brother hath a wife that believeth not, and she be pleased to dwell with him, let him not put her away.
new: But to the rest speak I, not Yahusha (Lord): If any brother hath a wife that believeth not, and she be pleased to dwell with him, let him not put her away.

old: For he that is called in Yahuah (Lord), being a servant, is Yahuah's (Lord’s) freeman: likewise also he that is called, being free, is Messiah's (Christ’s) servant.
new: For he that is called in Yahusha (Lord), being a servant, is Yahusha's (Lord’s) freeman: likewise also he that is called, being free, is Messiah's (Christ’s) servant.

old: Now concerning virgins I have no commandment of Yahuah (Lord): yet I give my judgment, as one that hath obtained mercy of Yahuah (Lord) to be faithful.
new: Now concerning virgins I have no commandment of Yahusha (Lord): yet I give my judgment, as one that hath obtained mercy of Yahusha (Lord) to be faithful.

old: But I would have you without carefulness. He that is unmarried careth for the things that belong to Yahuah (Lord), how he may please Yahuah (Lord):
new: But I would have you without carefulness. He that is unmarried careth for the things that belong to Yahusha (Lord), how he may please Yahusha (Lord):

old: There is difference also between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman careth for the things of Yahuah (Lord), that she may be holy both in body and in spirit: but she that is married careth for the things of the world, how she may please her husband.
new: There is difference also between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman careth for the things of Yahusha (Lord), that she may be holy both in body and in spirit: but she that is married careth for the things of the world, how she may please her husband.

old: And this I speak for your own profit; not that I may cast a snare upon you, but for that which is comely, and that ye may attend upon Yahuah (Lord) without distraction.
new: And this I speak for your own profit; not that I may cast a snare upon you, but for that which is comely, and that ye may attend upon Yahusha (Lord) without distraction.

old: The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband liveth; but if her husband be dead, she is at liberty to be married to whom she will; only in Yahuah (Lord).
new: The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband liveth; but if her husband be dead, she is at liberty to be married to whom she will; only in Yahusha (Lord).

old: Am I not an apostle? am I not free? have I not seen Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) our Lord? are not ye my work in Yahuah (Lord)?
new: Am I not an apostle? am I not free? have I not seen Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) our Lord? are not ye my work in Yahusha (Lord)?

old: If I be not an apostle unto others, yet doubtless I am to you: for the seal of mine apostleship are ye in Yahuah (Lord).
new: If I be not an apostle unto others, yet doubtless I am to you: for the seal of mine apostleship are ye in Yahusha (Lord).

old: Have we not power to lead about a sister, a wife, as well as other apostles, and as the brethren of Yahuah (Lord), and Cephas?
new: Have we not power to lead about a sister, a wife, as well as other apostles, and as the brethren of Yahusha (Lord), and Cephas?

old: Even so hath Yahuah (Lord) ordained that they which preach the gospel should live of the gospel.
new: Even so hath Yahusha (Lord) ordained that they which preach the gospel should live of the gospel.

old: Ye cannot drink the cup of Yahuah (Lord), and the cup of devils: ye cannot be partakers of Yahuah's (Lord’s) table, and of the table of devils.
new: Ye cannot drink the cup of Yahusha (Lord), and the cup of devils: ye cannot be partakers of Yahusha's (Lord’s) table, and of the table of devils.

old: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman, neither the woman without the man, in Yahuah (the Lord).
new: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman, neither the woman without the man, in Yahusha (the Lord).

old: And there are differences of administrations, but the same Yahuah (Lord).
new: And there are differences of administrations, but the same Adonai (Lord).

old: The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is Yahuah (Lord) from heaven.
new: The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is Adonai (Lord) from heaven.

old: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of Yahuah (Lord), forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in Yahuah (Lord).
new: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of Yahusha (Lord), forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in Yahusha (Lord).

old: Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he worketh the work of Yahuah (Lord), as I also do.
new: Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he worketh the work of Yahusha (Lord), as I also do.

old: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in Yahuah (Lord), with the church that is in their house.
new: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in Yahusha (Lord), with the church that is in their house.

old: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for Yahuah's (Lord’s) sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;
new: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for Yahusha's (Lord’s) sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;

old: And ye became followers of us, and of Yahuah (Lord), having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit):
new: And ye became followers of us, and of Yahusha (Lord), having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit):

old: For now we live, if ye stand fast in Yahuah (Lord).
new: For now we live, if ye stand fast in Yahusha (Lord).

old: And Yahuah (Lord) make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you:
new: And Yahusha (Lord) make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you:

old: For this we say unto you by the word of Yahuah (Lord), that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of Yahuah (Lord) shall not prevent them which are asleep.
new: For this we say unto you by the word of Yahusha (Lord), that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of Yahusha (Lord) shall not prevent them which are asleep.

old: For Yahuah (Lord) himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of Elohim (God): and the dead in Messiah (Christ) shall rise first:
new: For Yahusha (Lord) himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of Elohim (God): and the dead in Messiah (Christ) shall rise first:

old: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet Yahuah (Lord) in the air: and so shall we ever be with Yahuah (Lord).
new: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet Yahusha (Lord) in the air: and so shall we ever be with Yahusha (Lord).

old: And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in Yahuah (Lord), and admonish you;
new: And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in Yahusha (Lord), and admonish you;

old: I charge you by Yahuah (Lord) that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren.
new: I charge you by Yahusha (Lord) that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren.

old: For we preach not ourselves, but HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus) Yahuah (Lord); and ourselves your servants for Yahusha's (Jesus’) sake.
new: For we preach not ourselves, but HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus) Adonai (Lord); and ourselves your servants for Yahusha's (Jesus’) sake.

old: Therefore we are always confident, knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from Yahuah (Lord):
new: Therefore we are always confident, knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from Yahusha (Lord):

old: We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with Yahuah (Lord).
new: We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with Yahusha (Lord).

old: Knowing therefore the terror of Yahuah (Lord), we persuade men; but we are made manifest unto Elohim (God); and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.
new: Knowing therefore the terror of Yahusha (Lord), we persuade men; but we are made manifest unto Elohim (God); and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.

old: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which Yahuah (Lord) hath given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:
new: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which Yahusha (Lord) hath given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:

old: That which I speak, I speak it not after Yahuah (Lord), but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.
new: That which I speak, I speak it not after Yahusha (Lord), but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.

old: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of Yahuah (Lord).
new: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of Yahusha (Lord).

old: For this thing I besought Yahuah (Lord) thrice, that it might depart from me.
new: For this thing I besought Yahusha (Lord) thrice, that it might depart from me.

old: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which Yahuah (Lord) hath given me to edification, and not to destruction.
new: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which Yahusha (Lord) hath given me to edification, and not to destruction.

old: But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying Yahuah (Lord) that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction.
new: But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying Yahusha (Lord) that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction.

old: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of Yahuah (Lord) and Saviour Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), they are again entangled therein, and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.
new: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of Adonai (Lord) and Saviour Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), they are again entangled therein, and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.

old: That ye may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us the apostles of Yahuah (Lord) and Saviour:
new: That ye may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us the apostles of Adonai (Lord) and Saviour:

old: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom Yahuah (Lord) shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:
new: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom Yahusha (Lord) shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:

old: But Yahuah (Lord) is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.
new: But Yahusha (Lord) is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.

old: And we have confidence in Yahuah (Lord) touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command you.
new: And we have confidence in Yahusha (Lord) touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command you.

old: And Yahuah (Lord) direct your hearts into the love of Elohim (God), and into the patient waiting for Messiah (Christ).
new: And Yahusha (Lord) direct your hearts into the love of Elohim (God), and into the patient waiting for Messiah (Christ).

old: Now Yahuah (Lord) of peace himself give you peace always by all means. Yahuah (Lord) be with you all.
new: Now Adonai (Lord) of peace himself give you peace always by all means. Yahusha (Lord) be with you all.

old: Yahuah (Lord) give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:
new: Yahusha (Lord) give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:

old: Yahuah (Lord) grant unto him that he may find mercy of Yahuah (Lord) in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.
new: Yahusha (Lord) grant unto him that he may find mercy of Yahusha (Lord) in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.

old: Consider what I say; and Yahuah (Lord) give thee understanding in all things.
new: Consider what I say; and Yahusha (Lord) give thee understanding in all things.

old: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before Yahuah (Lord) that they strive not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.
new: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before Yahusha (Lord) that they strive not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.

old: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on Yahuah (Lord) out of a pure heart.
new: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on Yahusha (Lord) out of a pure heart.

old: And the servant of Yahuah (Lord) must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,
new: And the servant of Yahusha (Lord) must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,

old: Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all Yahuah (Lord) delivered me.
new: Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all Yahusha (Lord) delivered me.

old: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which Yahuah (Lord), the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.
new: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which Yahusha (Lord), the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.

old: Notwithstanding Yahuah (Lord) stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
new: Notwithstanding Yahusha (Lord) stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

old: And Yahuah (Lord) shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
new: And Yahusha (Lord) shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

old: When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Yahuah (Lord), wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Yashar'el (Israel)?
new: When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Adonai (Lord), wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Yashar'el (Israel)?

old: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Yahuah (Lord), lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.
new: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Adonai (Lord), lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.

old: And Saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of Yahuah (Lord), went unto the high priest,
new: And Saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of Yahusha (Lord), went unto the high priest,

old: And he said, Who art thou, Yahuah (Lord)? And Yahuah (Lord) said, I am Yahusha (Jesus) whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.
new: And he said, Who art thou, Adonai (Lord)? And Yahusha (Lord) said, I am Yahusha (Jesus) whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.

old: And he trembling and astonished said, Yahuah (Lord), what wilt thou have me to do? And Yahuah (Lord) said unto him, Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.
new: And he trembling and astonished said, Adonai (Lord), what wilt thou have me to do? And Yahusha (Lord) said unto him, Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.

old: And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said Yahuah (Lord) in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I am here, Yahuah (Lord).
new: And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said Yahusha (Lord) in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I am here, Adonai (Lord).

old: And Yahuah (Lord) said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and enquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth,
new: And Yahusha (Lord) said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and enquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth,

old: Then Ananias answered, Yahuah (Lord), I have heard by many of this man, how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem:
new: Then Ananias answered, Adonai (Lord), I have heard by many of this man, how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem:

old: But Yahuah (Lord) said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Yashar'el (Israel):
new: But Yahusha (Lord) said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Yashar'el (Israel):

old: And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, Yahuah (Lord), even Yahusha (Jesus), that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).
new: And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, Yahusha (Lord), even Yahusha (Jesus), that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).

old: But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared unto them how he had seen Yahuah (Lord) in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Yahusha (Jesus).
new: But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared unto them how he had seen Yahusha (Lord) in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Yahusha (Jesus).

old: The word which Elohim (God) sent unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), preaching peace by Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ): (he is Yahuah (Lord) of all:)
new: The word which Elohim (God) sent unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), preaching peace by Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ): (he is Adonai (Lord) of all:)

old: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of Yahuah (Lord). Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.
new: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of Yahusha (Lord). Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.

old: Then remembered I the word of Yahuah (Lord), how that he said, John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).
new: Then remembered I the word of Yahusha (Lord), how that he said, John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).

old: Then spake Yahuah (Lord) to Paul in the night by a vision, Be not afraid, but speak, and hold not thy peace:
new: Then spake Yahusha (Lord) to Paul in the night by a vision, Be not afraid, but speak, and hold not thy peace:

old: And I answered, Who art thou, Yahuah (Lord)? And he said unto me, I am Yahusha (Jesus) of Nazareth, whom thou persecutest.
new: And I answered, Who art thou, Adonai (Lord)? And he said unto me, I am Yahusha (Jesus) of Nazareth, whom thou persecutest.

old: And I said, What shall I do, Yahuah (Lord)? And Yahuah (Lord) said unto me, Arise, and go into Damascus; and there it shall be told thee of all things which are appointed for thee to do.
new: And I said, What shall I do, Adonai (Lord)? And Yahusha (Lord) said unto me, Arise, and go into Damascus; and there it shall be told thee of all things which are appointed for thee to do.

old: And I said, Yahuah (Lord), they know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue them that believed on thee:
new: And I said, Adonai (Lord), they know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue them that believed on thee:

old: And the night following Yahuah (Lord) stood by him, and said, Be of good cheer, Paul: for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem, so must thou bear witness also at Rome.
new: And the night following Yahusha (Lord) stood by him, and said, Be of good cheer, Paul: for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem, so must thou bear witness also at Rome.

old: And I said, Who art thou, Yahuah (Lord)? And he said, I am Yahusha (Jesus) whom thou persecutest.
new: And I said, Who art thou, Adonai (Lord)? And he said, I am Yahusha (Jesus) whom thou persecutest.

old: That ye might walk worthy of Yahuah (Lord) unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of Elohim (God);
new: That ye might walk worthy of Yahusha (Lord) unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of Elohim (God);

old: As ye have therefore received HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus) Yahuah (Lord), so walk ye in him:
new: As ye have therefore received HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus) Adonai (Lord), so walk ye in him:

old: Let the word of Messiah (Christ) dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to Yahuah (Lord).
new: Let the word of Messiah (Christ) dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to Yahusha (Lord).

old: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in Yahuah (Lord).
new: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in Yahusha (Lord).

old: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto Yahuah (Lord).
new: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto Yahusha (Lord).

old: And what soever ye do, do it heartily, as to Yahuah (Lord), and not unto men;
new: And what soever ye do, do it heartily, as to Yahusha (Lord), and not unto men;

old: Knowing that of Yahuah (Lord) ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve Yahuah (Lord) Messiah (Christ).
new: Knowing that of Yahusha (Lord) ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve Adonai (Lord) Messiah (Christ).

old: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in Yahuah (Lord):
new: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in Yahusha (Lord):

old: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in Yahuah (Lord), that thou fulfil it.
new: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in Yahusha (Lord), that thou fulfil it.

old: In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in Yahuah (Lord):
new: In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in Yahusha (Lord):

old: I therefore, the prisoner of Yahuah (Lord), beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called,
new: I therefore, the prisoner of Yahusha (Lord), beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called,

old: One Yahuah (Lord), one faith, one baptism,
new: One Adonai (Lord), one faith, one baptism,

old: This I say therefore, and testify in Yahuah (Lord), that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,
new: This I say therefore, and testify in Yahusha (Lord), that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,

old: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in Yahuah (Lord): walk as children of light:
new: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in Yahusha (Lord): walk as children of light:

old: Proving what is acceptable unto Yahuah (Lord).
new: Proving what is acceptable unto Yahusha (Lord).

old: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to Yahuah (Lord);
new: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to Yahusha (Lord);

old: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto Yahuah (Lord).
new: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto Yahusha (Lord).

old: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as Yahuah (Lord) the church:
new: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as Yahusha (Lord) the church:

old: Children, obey your parents in Yahuah (Lord): for this is right.
new: Children, obey your parents in Yahusha (Lord): for this is right.

old: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of Yahuah (Lord).
new: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of Yahusha (Lord).

old: With good will doing service, as to Yahuah (Lord), and not to men:
new: With good will doing service, as to Yahusha (Lord), and not to men:

old: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of Yahuah (Lord), whether he be bond or free.
new: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of Yahusha (Lord), whether he be bond or free.

old: Finally, my brethren, be strong in Yahuah (Lord), and in the power of his might.
new: Finally, my brethren, be strong in Yahusha (Lord), and in the power of his might.

old: But that ye also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in Yahuah (Lord), shall make known to you all things:
new: But that ye also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in Yahusha (Lord), shall make known to you all things:

old: I have confidence in you through Yahuah (Lord), that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.
new: I have confidence in you through Yahusha (Lord), that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.

old: How shall we escape, if we neglect so great salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by Yahuah (Lord), and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him;
new: How shall we escape, if we neglect so great salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by Yahusha (Lord), and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him;

old: My brethren, have not the faith of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Lord Jesus Christ), Yahuah (Lord) of glory, with respect of persons.
new: My brethren, have not the faith of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Lord Jesus Christ), Adonai (Lord) of glory, with respect of persons.

old: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of Yahuah (Lord). Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.
new: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of Yahusha (Lord). Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.

old: Be ye also patient; stablish your hearts: for the coming of Yahuah (Lord) draweth nigh.
new: Be ye also patient; stablish your hearts: for the coming of Yahusha (Lord) draweth nigh.

old: When therefore Yahuah (Lord) knew how the Pharisees had heard that Yahusha (Jesus) made and baptized more disciples than John,
new: When therefore Yahusha (Lord) knew how the Pharisees had heard that Yahusha (Jesus) made and baptized more disciples than John,

old: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that Yahuah (Lord) had given thanks:)
new: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that Yahusha (Lord) had given thanks:)

old: Then said they unto him, Yahuah (Lord), evermore give us this bread.
new: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.

old: She said, No man, Yahuah (Lord). And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.
new: She said, No man, Lord. And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.

old: He answered and said, Who is he, Yahuah (Lord), that I might believe on him?
new: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?

old: (It was that Mary which anointed Yahuah (Lord) with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)
new: (It was that Mary which anointed Yahusha (Lord) with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)

old: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Yahuah (Lord), behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.
new: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Adonai (Lord), behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.

old: Then said his disciples, Yahuah (Lord), if he sleep, he shall do well.
new: Then said his disciples, Adonai (Lord), if he sleep, he shall do well.

old: Then said Martha unto Yahusha (Jesus), Yahuah (Lord), if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
new: Then said Martha unto Yahusha (Jesus), Adonai (Lord), if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

old: Then when Mary was come where Yahusha (Jesus) was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Yahuah (Lord), if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
new: Then when Mary was come where Yahusha (Jesus) was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Adonai (Lord), if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

old: And said, Where have ye laid him? They said unto him, Yahuah (Lord), come and see.
new: And said, Where have ye laid him? They said unto him, Adonai (Lord), come and see.

old: Yahusha (Jesus) said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Yahuah (Lord), by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.
new: Yahusha (Jesus) said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Adonai (Lord), by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.

old: Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him, Yahuah (Lord), dost thou wash my feet?
new: Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him, Adonai (Lord), dost thou wash my feet?

old: Simon Peter saith unto him, Yahuah (Lord), not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.
new: Simon Peter saith unto him, Adonai (Lord), not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.

old: He then lying on Yahusha's (Jesus’) breast saith unto him, Yahuah (Lord), who is it?
new: He then lying on Yahusha's (Jesus’) breast saith unto him, Adonai (Lord), who is it?

old: Simon Peter said unto him, Yahuah (Lord), whither goest thou? Yahusha (Jesus) answered him, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.
new: Simon Peter said unto him, Adonai (Lord), whither goest thou? Yahusha (Jesus) answered him, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.

old: Peter said unto him, Yahuah (Lord), why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thy sake.
new: Peter said unto him, Adonai (Lord), why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thy sake.

old: Philip saith unto him, Yahuah (Lord), shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.
new: Philip saith unto him, Adonai (Lord), shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.

old: Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Yahuah (Lord), how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?
new: Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Adonai (Lord), how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?

old: Then she runneth, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Yahusha (Jesus) loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away Yahuah (Lord) out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.
new: Then she runneth, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Yahusha (Jesus) loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away Yahusha (Lord) out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.

old: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen Yahuah (Lord), and that he had spoken these things unto her.
new: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen Yahusha (Lord), and that he had spoken these things unto her.

old: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw Yahuah (Lord).
new: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw Yahusha (Lord).

old: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen Yahuah (Lord). But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.
new: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen Yahusha (Lord). But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.

old: Therefore that disciple whom Yahusha (Jesus) loved saith unto Peter, It is Yahuah (Lord). Now when Simon Peter heard that it was Yahuah (Lord), he girt his fisher’s coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.
new: Therefore that disciple whom Yahusha (Jesus) loved saith unto Peter, It is Yahusha (Lord). Now when Simon Peter heard that it was Yahusha (Lord), he girt his fisher’s coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.

old: Yahusha (Jesus) saith unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was Yahuah (Lord).
new: Yahusha (Jesus) saith unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was Yahusha (Lord).

old: So when they had dined, Yahusha (Jesus) saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Yahuah (Lord); thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.
new: So when they had dined, Yahusha (Jesus) saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Adonai (Lord); thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.

old: He saith to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Yahuah (Lord); thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
new: He saith to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Adonai (Lord); thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

old: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Yahuah (Lord), thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Yahusha (Jesus) saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
new: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Adonai (Lord), thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Yahusha (Jesus) saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

old: Then Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Yahusha (Jesus) loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Yahuah (Lord), which is he that betrayeth thee?
new: Then Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Yahusha (Jesus) loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Adonai (Lord), which is he that betrayeth thee?

old: Peter seeing him saith to Yahusha (Jesus), Yahuah (Lord), and what shall this man do?
new: Peter seeing him saith to Yahusha (Jesus), Adonai (Lord), and what shall this man do?

old: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Messiah (Christ) Yahuah (Lord).
new: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Messiah (Christ) Adonai (Lord).

old: When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Yahusha's (Jesus’) knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Yahuah (Lord).
new: When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Yahusha's (Jesus’) knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Adonai (Lord).

old: And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Yahusha (Jesus) fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Yahuah (Lord), if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
new: And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Yahusha (Jesus) fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Adonai (Lord), if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

old: And he said unto them, That the Son of Adam is Yahuah (Lord) also of the sabbath.
new: And he said unto them, That the Son of Adam is Adonai (Lord) also of the sabbath.

old: And why call ye me, Yahuah (Lord), Yahuah (Lord), and do not the things which I say?
new: And why call ye me, Adonai (Lord), Adonai (Lord), and do not the things which I say?

old: Then Yahusha (Jesus) went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Yahuah (Lord), trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof:
new: Then Yahusha (Jesus) went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Adonai (Lord), trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof:

old: And when Yahuah (Lord) saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.
new: And when Yahusha (Lord) saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.

old: And Yahuah (Lord) said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?
new: And Yahusha (Lord) said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?

old: And it came to pass, that, as they went in the way, a certain man said unto him, Yahuah (Lord), I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
new: And it came to pass, that, as they went in the way, a certain man said unto him, Adonai (Lord), I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.

old: And he said unto another, Follow me. But he said, Yahuah (Lord), suffer me first to go and bury my father.
new: And he said unto another, Follow me. But he said, Adonai (Lord), suffer me first to go and bury my father.

old: And another also said, Yahuah (Lord), I will follow thee; but let me first go bid them farewell, which are at home at my house.
new: And another also said, Adonai (Lord), I will follow thee; but let me first go bid them farewell, which are at home at my house.

old: After these things Yahuah (Lord) appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.
new: After these things Yahusha (Lord) appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.

old: And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Yahuah (Lord), even the devils are subject unto us through thy name.
new: And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Adonai (Lord), even the devils are subject unto us through thy name.

old: And Yahuah (Lord) said unto him, Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.
new: And Yahusha (Lord) said unto him, Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.

old: Then Peter said unto him, Yahuah (Lord), speakest thou this parable unto us, or even to all?
new: Then Peter said unto him, Adonai (Lord), speakest thou this parable unto us, or even to all?

old: And Yahuah (Lord) said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall make ruler over his household, to give them their portion of meat in due season?
new: And Yahusha (Lord) said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall make ruler over his household, to give them their portion of meat in due season?

old: And he answering said unto him, Yahuah (Lord), let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung it:
new: And he answering said unto him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung it:

old: Yahuah (Lord) then answered him, and said, Thou hypocrite, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him away to watering?
new: Yahusha (Lord) then answered him, and said, Thou hypocrite, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him away to watering?

old: Then said one unto him, Yahuah (Lord), are there few that be saved? And he said unto them,
new: Then said one unto him, Adonai (Lord), are there few that be saved? And he said unto them,

old: When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Yahuah (Lord), Yahuah (Lord), open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence ye are:
new: When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Adonai (Lord), Adonai (Lord), open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence ye are:

old: And the servant said, Yahuah (Lord), it is done as thou hast commanded, and yet there is room.
new: And the servant said, Lord, it is done as thou hast commanded, and yet there is room.

old: And Yahuah (Lord) said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye might say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou plucked up by the root, and be thou planted in the sea; and it should obey you.
new: And Yahusha (Lord) said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye might say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou plucked up by the root, and be thou planted in the sea; and it should obey you.

old: And they answered and said unto him, Where, Yahuah (Lord)? And he said unto them, Wheresoever the body is, thither will the eagles be gathered together.
new: And they answered and said unto him, Where, Adonai (Lord)? And he said unto them, Wheresoever the body is, thither will the eagles be gathered together.

old: And Yahuah (Lord) said, Hear what the unjust judge saith.
new: And Yahusha (Lord) said, Hear what the unjust judge saith.

old: Saying, What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee? And he said, Yahuah (Lord), that I may receive my sight.
new: Saying, What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee? And he said, Adonai (Lord), that I may receive my sight.

old: And Zacchæus stood, and said unto Yahuah (Lord); Behold, Yahuah (Lord), the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.
new: And Zacchæus stood, and said unto Yahusha (Lord); Behold, Adonai (Lord), the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.

old: Then came the first, saying, Yahuah (Lord), thy pound hath gained ten pounds.
new: Then came the first, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained ten pounds.

old: And the second came, saying, Yahuah (Lord), thy pound hath gained five pounds.
new: And the second came, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained five pounds.

old: And another came, saying, Yahuah (Lord), behold, here is thy pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin:
new: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, here is thy pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin:

old: (And they said unto him, Yahuah (Lord), he hath ten pounds.)
new: (And they said unto him, Lord, he hath ten pounds.)

old: And if any man ask you, Why do ye loose him? thus shall ye say unto him, Because Yahuah (Lord) hath need of him.
new: And if any man ask you, Why do ye loose him? thus shall ye say unto him, Because Yahusha (Lord) hath need of him.

old: And they said, Yahuah (Lord) hath need of him.
new: And they said, Yahusha (Lord) hath need of him.

old: David therefore calleth him Yahuah (Lord), how is he then his son?
new: David therefore calleth him Adonai (Lord), how is he then his son?

old: And Yahuah (Lord) said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat:
new: And Yahusha (Lord) said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat:

old: And he said unto him, Yahuah (Lord), I am ready to go with thee, both into prison, and to death.
new: And he said unto him, Adonai (Lord), I am ready to go with thee, both into prison, and to death.

old: And they said, Yahuah (Lord), behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.
new: And they said, Adonai (Lord), behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.

old: And Yahuah (Lord) turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered the word of Yahuah (Lord), how he had said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
new: And Yahusha (Lord) turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered the word of Yahusha (Lord), how he had said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.

old: And he said unto Yahusha (Jesus), Yahuah (Lord), remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom.
new: And he said unto Yahusha (Jesus), Adonai (Lord), remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom.

old: Saying, Yahuah (Lord) is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.
new: Saying, Yahusha (Lord) is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.

old: Therefore the Son of Adam is Yahuah (Lord) also of the sabbath.
new: Therefore the Son of Adam is Adonai (Lord) also of the sabbath.

old: And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Yahuah (Lord): yet the dogs under the table eat of the children’s crumbs.
new: And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Adonai (Lord): yet the dogs under the table eat of the children’s crumbs.

old: And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Yahuah (Lord), I believe; help thou mine unbelief.
new: And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Adonai (Lord), I believe; help thou mine unbelief.

old: And Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto him, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? The blind man said unto him, Yahuah (Lord), that I might receive my sight.
new: And Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto him, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? The blind man said unto him, Adonai (Lord), that I might receive my sight.

old: And if any man say unto you, Why do ye this? say ye that Yahuah (Lord) hath need of him; and straightway he will send him hither.
new: And if any man say unto you, Why do ye this? say ye that Yahusha (Lord) hath need of him; and straightway he will send him hither.

old: David therefore himself calleth him Yahuah (Lord); and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard him gladly.
new: David therefore himself calleth him Adonai (Lord); and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard him gladly.

old: So then after Yahuah (Lord) had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of Elohim (God).
new: So then after Yahusha (Lord) had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of Elohim (God).

old: And they went forth, and preached every where, Yahuah (Lord) working with them, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.
new: And they went forth, and preached every where, Yahusha (Lord) working with them, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.

old: Not every one that saith unto me, Yahuah (Lord), Yahuah (Lord), shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.
new: Not every one that saith unto me, Adonai (Lord), Adonai (Lord), shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.

old: Many will say to me in that day, Yahuah (Lord), Yahuah (Lord), have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?
new: Many will say to me in that day, Adonai (Lord), Adonai (Lord), have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?

old: And, behold, there came a leper and worshipped him, saying, Yahuah (Lord), if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
new: And, behold, there came a leper and worshipped him, saying, Adonai (Lord), if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

old: And saying, Yahuah (Lord), my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.
new: And saying, Adonai (Lord), my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.

old: The centurion answered and said, Yahuah (Lord), I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed.
new: The centurion answered and said, Adonai (Lord), I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed.

old: And another of his disciples said unto him, Yahuah (Lord), suffer me first to go and bury my father.
new: And another of his disciples said unto him, Adonai (Lord), suffer me first to go and bury my father.

old: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Yahusha (Jesus) saith unto them, Believe ye that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Yahuah (Lord).
new: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Yahusha (Jesus) saith unto them, Believe ye that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Adonai (Lord).

old: For the Son of Adam is Yahuah (Lord) even of the sabbath day.
new: For the Son of Adam is Adonai (Lord) even of the sabbath day.

old: Yahusha (Jesus) saith unto them, Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Yahuah (Lord).
new: Yahusha (Jesus) saith unto them, Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Adonai (Lord).

old: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Yahuah (Lord), thou Son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.
new: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Adonai (Lord), thou Son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.

old: Then came she and worshipped him, saying, Yahuah (Lord), help me.
new: Then came she and worshipped him, saying, Adonai (Lord), help me.

old: And she said, Truth, Yahuah (Lord): yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.
new: And she said, Truth, Adonai (Lord): yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.

old: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Yahuah (Lord): this shall not be unto thee.
new: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Adonai (Lord): this shall not be unto thee.

old: Yahuah (Lord), have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falleth into the fire, and oft into the water.
new: Adonai (Lord), have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falleth into the fire, and oft into the water.

old: Then came Peter to him, and said, Yahuah (Lord), how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?
new: Then came Peter to him, and said, Adonai (Lord), how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?

old: The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Yahuah (Lord), have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
new: The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.

old: And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Yahusha (Jesus) passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Yahuah (Lord), thou Son of David.
new: And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Yahusha (Jesus) passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Adonai (Lord), thou Son of David.

old: And the multitude rebuked them, because they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Yahuah (Lord), thou Son of David.
new: And the multitude rebuked them, because they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Adonai (Lord), thou Son of David.

old: They say unto him, Yahuah (Lord), that our eyes may be opened.
new: They say unto him, Adonai (Lord), that our eyes may be opened.

old: And if any man say ought unto you, ye shall say, Yahuah (Lord) hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.
new: And if any man say ought unto you, ye shall say, Yahusha (Lord) hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.

old: He saith unto them, How then doth David in spirit call him Yahuah (Lord), saying,
new: He saith unto them, How then doth David in spirit call him Adonai (Lord), saying,

old: If David then call him Yahuah (Lord), how is he his son?
new: If David then call him Adonai (Lord), how is he his son?

old: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Yahuah (Lord), Yahuah (Lord), open to us.
new: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Adonai (Lord), Adonai (Lord), open to us.

old: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Yahuah (Lord), thou deliveredst unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.
new: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.

old: He also that had received two talents came and said, Yahuah (Lord), thou deliveredst unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.
new: He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.

old: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Yahuah (Lord), I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:
new: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:

old: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Yahuah (Lord), when saw we thee an hungred, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink?
new: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Adonai (Lord), when saw we thee an hungred, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink?

old: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Yahuah (Lord), when saw we thee an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?
new: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Adonai (Lord), when saw we thee an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?

old: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Yahuah (Lord), is it I?
new: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Adonai (Lord), is it I?

old: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where Yahuah (Lord) lay.
new: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where Yahusha (Lord) lay.

old: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in Yahuah (Lord)?
new: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in Yahusha (Lord)?

old: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in Yahuah (Lord): refresh my bowels in Yahuah (Lord).
new: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in Yahusha (Lord): refresh my bowels in Yahusha (Lord).

old: And many of the brethren in Yahuah (Lord), waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.
new: And many of the brethren in Yahusha (Lord), waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.

old: But I trust in Yahuah (Lord) that I also myself shall come shortly.
new: But I trust in Yahusha (Lord) that I also myself shall come shortly.

old: Receive him therefore in Yahuah (Lord) with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:
new: Receive him therefore in Yahusha (Lord) with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:

old: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in Yahuah (Lord). To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.
new: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in Yahusha (Lord). To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.

old: Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in Yahuah (Lord), my dearly beloved.
new: Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in Yahusha (Lord), my dearly beloved.

old: I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in Yahuah (Lord).
new: I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in Yahusha (Lord).

old: Rejoice in Yahuah (Lord) alway: and again I say, Rejoice.
new: Rejoice in Yahusha (Lord) alway: and again I say, Rejoice.

old: Let your moderation be known unto all men. Yahuah (Lord) is at hand.
new: Let your moderation be known unto all men. Yahusha (Lord) is at hand.

old: But I rejoiced in Yahuah (Lord) greatly, that now at the last your care of me hath flourished again; wherein ye were also careful, but ye lacked opportunity.
new: But I rejoiced in Yahusha (Lord) greatly, that now at the last your care of me hath flourished again; wherein ye were also careful, but ye lacked opportunity.

old: And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Write, Blessed are the dead which die in Yahuah (Lord) from henceforth: Yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them.
new: And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Write, Blessed are the dead which die in Yahusha (Lord) from henceforth: Yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them.

old: He that regardeth the day, regardeth it unto Yahuah (Lord); and he that regardeth not the day, to Yahuah (Lord) he doth not regard it. He that eateth, eateth to Yahuah (Lord), for he giveth Elohim (God) thanks; and he that eateth not, to Yahuah (Lord) he eateth not, and giveth Elohim (God) thanks.
new: He that regardeth the day, regardeth it unto Yahusha (Lord); and he that regardeth not the day, to Yahusha (Lord) he doth not regard it. He that eateth, eateth to Yahusha (Lord), for he giveth Elohim (God) thanks; and he that eateth not, to Yahusha (Lord) he eateth not, and giveth Elohim (God) thanks.

old: For whether we live, we live unto Yahuah (Lord); and whether we die, we die unto Yahuah (Lord): whether we live therefore, or die, we are Yahuah's (Lord’s).
new: For whether we live, we live unto Yahusha (Lord); and whether we die, we die unto Yahusha (Lord): whether we live therefore, or die, we are Yahusha's (Lord’s).

old: For to this end Messiah (Christ) both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be Yahuah (Lord) both of the dead and living.
new: For to this end Messiah (Christ) both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be Adonai (Lord) both of the dead and living.

old: That ye receive her in Yahuah (Lord), as becometh saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever business she hath need of you: for she hath been a succourer of many, and of myself also.
new: That ye receive her in Yahusha (Lord), as becometh saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever business she hath need of you: for she hath been a succourer of many, and of myself also.

old: Greet Amplias my beloved in Yahuah (Lord).
new: Greet Amplias my beloved in Yahusha (Lord).

old: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in Yahuah (Lord).
new: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in Yahusha (Lord).

old: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labour in Yahuah (Lord). Salute the beloved Persis, which laboured much in Yahuah (Lord).
new: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labour in Yahusha (Lord). Salute the beloved Persis, which laboured much in Yahusha (Lord).

old: Salute Rufus chosen in Yahuah (Lord), and his mother and mine.
new: Salute Rufus chosen in Yahusha (Lord), and his mother and mine.

old: I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in Yahuah (Lord).
new: I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in Yahusha (Lord).
